inactiveHelp: Flying manually. Velocity and position assist require DVL bottom lock; both pause outside its altitude range.
limitedHelp: Insufficient thrust to maintain the command, for example in strong currents.

too_high: No DVL bottom return ({alt} m above bottom)
Descend closer to the seabed to restore it automatically.
range: Weak DVL return ({alt} m above bottom)
Descend closer to the seabed to restore it automatically.
window: Altitude outside the DVL operating range
Return to an altitude above 0.5 m with the seabed in view.
too_low: Too close to the bottom for DVL measurement
Ascend slightly; it restores automatically above 0.5 m.
slope: Steep slope below; DVL bottom lock lost
vegetation: Seagrass or algae obstructing DVL beams
Ascend slightly or move above sand.
silt: Stop thrusting and let sediment settle, or leave the cloud.
aeration: Thrusters entraining bubbles near the surface interfere with DVL
Descend away from the surface to restore it.
mud: Soft mud bottom return too weak
Ascend slightly or move above firmer seabed.
pool: Pool wall echoes interfering with DVL
Move to the centre of the pool.
fault: Switch to manual control and inspect after the dive.
net: DVL beams hit the pen net
tilt: Vehicle tilt exceeds the DVL operating range
